description: Additional core stdlib packages (path, uuid, kv, cache) and end-to-end integration test demonstrating a working web application that uses routing, JSON responses, environment variables, logging, and basic state management via kv store.
steps: Implement the 'path' package in src/stdlib_path.c: path.join(parts...) joins URL path segments with '/', path.normalize(p) removes double slashes and trailing slash, path.basename(p) returns last segment, path.dirname(p) returns parent path

Implement the 'uuid' package in src/stdlib_uuid.c: uuid.v4() generates a random UUID v4 string (using /dev/urandom for random bytes, formatting as 8-4-4-4-12 hex with version/variant bits set correctly)

Implement the 'kv' package in src/stdlib_kv.c: kv.set(key, value) stores a value, kv.get(key) retrieves it (or nil), kv.delete(key) removes it, kv.clear() removes all. Implemented as an ObjMap stored globally in the VM. Optional TTL support: kv.set(key, value, ttl: seconds) expires entries lazily on get.

Implement the 'cache' package in src/stdlib_cache.c: cache.get(key) returns cached value or nil, cache.set(key, value, ttl: seconds), cache.delete(key). Simpler than kv - always has TTL, used for computed values.

Create a comprehensive integration test: tests/programs/web_app.ve that defines multiple routes (GET /, GET /api/status returning JSON, GET /api/echo/:msg returning the param, POST /api/kv to store a value), uses log.info for request logging, env for config. Create corresponding .expected file or a shell-based test.

Create tests/test_http_integration.sh that: starts the web app server, exercises multiple endpoints with curl, validates JSON responses, tests 404 handling, tests path params, then shuts down. Hook this into 'make test' or a separate 'make test_integration_http' target.
Ensure all stdlib packages are properly initialized in stdlib_init() and documented in the test output
acceptance_criteria: make compiles with all new stdlib files
uuid.v4() returns a valid UUID string (36 chars, correct format)
The web app integration test demonstrates a full request/response cycle with JSON encoding
The HTTP integration test exercises at least 5 different endpoint scenarios
